read: Management delivers on annual PAT and capex targets, while revenue growth frequently misses initial guidance. Most targets are currently pending as FY27 unfolds.
questions: Why did supply chain revenue growth slow down in Q1 FY27 despite earlier 15% targets?
How will rising bunker prices at Rs 86,000 per ton impact seaways margins in Q2?

Capex execution remains close to budget with Rs 167 crore spent in Q1 FY27.
bear: Standalone PAT turned slightly negative in Q1 FY27 due to lower JV dividends.
Bunker prices escalated to Rs 86,000 per ton, compressing seaways margins.
